title: Per-route SLI drilldowns and cost-trace alerting for embeddings & rerank
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Goal: Provide engineers and SREs per-route SLI drilldowns, token-and-op-level cost attribution, and adaptive alerting for embeddings and reranking endpoints. This ticket covers instrumentation additions, dashboard design, alert rules, and a short rollout plan for Canary routes. The aim is to reduce time-to-detect quality regressions and cost anomalies while keeping runbook actions well-scoped.

Success criteria (measurable):
- Per-route dashboards available in Grafana with p50/p90/p99 latency, token throughput, KV cache hit rates, and cost-per-request (USD) slices for top 10 routes.
- Distributed traces include standard span naming for embed->rank pipeline and per-span token counts so tail-latency root causes can be attributed.
- Alerts that distinguish quality regressions (embedding similarity drop) from infra regressions (GPU overload) with <= 5m alert-firing time and documented runbook.
- Demo with two Canary customers showing cost savings via route-level batching/quantization suggestions.

Out of scope: full billing integration for enterprise chargeback, long-term retention changes, and embedding quality A/B evaluation harness (handled in separate ticket).
acceptance_criteria: Grafana dashboard per-route published and linked from Console route settings
Trace schema changes deployed: span names embed.request, rerank.score, rerank.kv_cache_lookup with token_count tag
Cost slices computed hourly and surfaced as cost_per_1000_tokens metric for each route
Alert rules for latency increases (>2x baseline p95 for 5m) and cost spikes (>3x baseline hourly) with separate notification channels
Runbook created with triage steps and ownership assigned to embeddings-oncall
technical_design_notes: Add token_count and model_variant tags to request-level metrics to allow aggregation by route and model
Emit span events at key checkpoints: tokenize.start/end, embed.infer.start/end, rerank.kv_lookup.start/end, rerank.score.start/end
Instrument KV cache to report hit/miss per-request using existing cache-metrics library; expose per-route hit_rate metric
Cost attribution: compute cost_per_token using model variant pricing table, multiply by token_count and aggregate per-route (hourly) into metric cost_per_1000_tokens.route.<route_name>
Tracing: ensure sampled traces include full token counts when sampled_flag=1; add a small deterministic sampling path for SLI breaches to capture tail traces

Dashboard: single templated dashboard with route dropdown; panels for latency curves, token throughput, cache hit heatmap, cost-per-1000 tokens, and top contributing spans by duration (using span_grouping)

Alerts: create separate Prometheus rules for infra (GPU_util>85% and p95 latency > baseline*2) and embedding quality (average rerank.similarity_score drop > 10% over 15m). Quality alerts should include a pre-run query to surface affected route example requests.
Backfill: compute 7-day historical cost slices for anomaly baselining using daily-job job-embed-cost-backfill

Canary rollout to two routes + customer demo (ENG-91234.7)
